plan: In a second-price sealed-bid auction, bidding your true value is a dominant strategy regardless of what other bidders do. This is because you pay the second-highest bid if you win, not your own bid, so there's no incentive to shade your bid. Bidding truthfully maximizes expected profit: if I bid higher than my value, I risk winning and paying more than the item is worth to me; if I bid lower, I risk losing profitable opportunities. With my value at $18, I will bid exactly $18.
